title: TELOS
author: irpina
description: Mods from the CF card for the Octatrack (OS 1.40C): at the card's first mount it links the .elemod files /ELEKLOADER/MODS/active names into a 2 MB area, sites included, writes /ELEKLOADER/MODS/status.txt, and lists the card's mods in MAIN MENU > MODS (settings-ot 0.2), where YES ticks one after the boot's checks and APPLY saves the set for the next start. The design is research/telos-ot.
